Definition: from G575 and G1643; to dismiss:--drive.
BiblicalUsage: To drive away — Gallio driving the accusers from the judgment seat, refusing to judge a dispute about words and names. The word appears only here, and it is a judge washing his hands of a case.
TheologicalSignificance: I take Gallio's dismissal as a small mercy: the gospel was left alone to spread while its enemies were shown the door.
